description: Minecraft mod that turns a button into a working fire sprinkler

mods.name: Fire Sprinkler
mods.description: Place a button on the underside of a waterlogged block (or a block below a water source) to make it act as a fire sprinkler: fires within a downward spray cone are extinguished like rain, with hiss and smoke, and burning mobs are put out too. Server-side only.

releases.notes:
**Minecraft 26.x | Fabric and NeoForge**

A button on the underside of a waterlogged block (or a block below a water source) acts as a fire sprinkler: fire in the spray cone below is put out like rain, with hiss and steam, and burning mobs are extinguished too. Server-side/standalone only — no client mod required.

- `firesprinkler-fabric-26.0.3.jar` — Fabric
- `firesprinkler-neoforge-26.0.3.jar` — NeoForge
